tagline.zh: 不会画画没关系，会说话就行
tagline.en: Can't draw? Doesn't matter. You can talk

story.zh: 团队要做文化衫，设计师排期排到了明年。Qoder CLI 内置了生图工具 ImageGen，在终端里说一句话就能出图。
story.en: The team wants T-shirts and the designer is booked until next year. Qoder CLI ships with an image tool, ImageGen: say a sentence in the terminal and get a picture.

goal.zh: 得到一张吉祥物，在「预览」里看，不满意就让它改。
goal.en: End up with a mascot, look at it in the Preview tab, and ask for changes until you like it.

openingPrompt.zh: 用内置的 ImageGen 工具给我的团队画一个吉祥物：一只戴耳机的柴犬程序员，抱着笔记本电脑，扁平贴纸风，白色背景。图片名字用 mascot
openingPrompt.en: Use the built-in ImageGen tool to draw a mascot for my team: a shiba inu programmer wearing headphones and hugging a laptop, flat sticker style, white background. Name the image mascot

hint.zh: 按回车发送。想换动物、换风格，发送前直接改提示词。出图后点「预览」。
hint.en: Press Enter. Want another animal or style? Edit the prompt before sending. Open Preview once the image is done.

hint.zh: 提个修改意见，像对设计师那样。
hint.en: Give feedback like you would to a designer.

prompt.zh: 再画一版，图片名字还用 mascot：同一只柴犬，但是它在凌晨三点改 bug，黑眼圈，桌上三杯咖啡
prompt.en: Draw another version, still named mascot: the same shiba, but fixing a bug at 3am, dark circles under its eyes, three coffees on the desk
